mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening housing market that contracts consumer demand, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production contractions (INDPRO < 100), manufacturing output decline reduces corporate profitability and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent price pressures that trigger hawkish monetary policy expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) over three consecutive months indicates robust consumer demand growth that supports corporate revenue, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS increases for three consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500.0 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO > 100) indicates expanding manufacturing output that supports corporate production and profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
